# Karban

> > Karban manufactures innovative 3-in-1 bladeless ceiling fans with integrated air purification and smart lighting technology for modern Indian homes.

Karban is an Indian company specializing in smart home appliances that combine air purification, bladeless fan technology, and modular lighting. Founded by engineer Karan Bansal, the company leverages CFD and BLDC motor innovations to deliver sustainable, energy-efficient solutions with smart home integration.

## Key Topics

- Bladeless ceiling fan
- Air purifier
- Smart home integration
- HEPA filter
- PM2.5 & PM10 filtration
- BLDC motor technology
- CFD engineering
- Karban Airzone
- Karban Airzone+
- Lumone pendant light
- Energy efficiency
- BIS certification
- Panasonic partnership
- Annual maintenance contract
- Sustainability & ESG

## Products

- [Karban Airzone](https://karban.in/products/karban-airzone): Flagship 3-in-1 bladeless fan with air purifier and smart home features
- [Karban Airzone+](https://karban.in/products/karban-airzone-1): Premium model designed for large spaces with advanced smart controls
- [Lumone](https://karban.in/products/lumone): Modular pendant light with tunable color temperature and smart integration
- [Product Collection](https://karban.in/collections/product-collection): Complete catalog of Karban products with specs and comparisons
- [HEPA Filter](https://karban.in/products/hepa-filter): Replacement HEPA filter refills for Airzone and Airzone+ units
